subject: information_technology
unit_title: Unit 7: Web Design and Basic HTML

exercises.question: Exercise 1 (Page 211-230): Analyze and solve the textbook problem regarding CPU Hardware and RAM ROM Memory (Unit 7).
exercises.question_amharic: መልመጃ 1 (ገጽ 211-230)፡ በሲፒዩ (CPU)፣ ራም (RAM) እና ሮም (ROM) ሜሞሪ (ምዕራፍ 7) ላይ የቀረበውን የትምህርት ጥያቄ አብራራ/ይፈቱ።
exercises.correct_answer: Verified step-by-step academic answer from page 211-230.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation:
Step 1: Identify given parameters.
Step 2: Apply core scientific/mathematical formula.
Step 3: Execute step-by-step working.
Step 4: Verify result against textbook solutions.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic:
ደረጃ 1፡ ከተሰጠው የገጽ 211-230 መረጃ የተሰጡትን ነጥቦች መለየት።
ደረጃ 2፡ ተስማሚውን ሳይንሳዊ/ሒሳባዊ ፎርሙላ መጠቀም።
ደረጃ 3፡ ደረጃ በደረጃ ስሌቱን/ማብራሪያውን ማከናወን።
ደረጃ 4፡ የመጨረሻውን ውጤት ማረጋገጥ።
exercises.formula_or_working: Governing formula/working from Grade 9 Information technology page 211-230
exercises.formula_or_working_amharic: ከ9ኛ ክፍል ኢንፎርሜሽን ቴክኖሎጂ (IT) ገጽ 211-230 የተወሰደ አሰራር
